TABLE.NAME: theme_dimensions_cat
TABLE.COMMENT: The hero of a course category on the category showcase: layout, colours, overlay, tagline, card text, default organisation and public description. Only a branded category has a row; absence means the defaults.

FIELD.NAME: bgcolour
FIELD.COMMENT: The band colour, #rrggbb, lower case; the institutional navy by default.

FIELD.NAME: inkcolour
FIELD.COMMENT: The colour of the text on the band, #rrggbb, lower case; white by default.

FIELD.NAME: owncolours
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when bgcolour and inkcolour are this category's own; 0 when the category takes the pair of its nearest ancestor that has one, or the theme's default pair.

FIELD.NAME: overlay
FIELD.COMMENT: How much of the colour covers the photograph, in percent: 0, 60, 78 or 90.

FIELD.NAME: chamada
FIELD.COMMENT: The tagline under the category name: one sentence, empty for none.

FIELD.NAME: publicsummary
FIELD.COMMENT: The short public description a share preview shows (og:description), at most 200 characters; empty means no og:description.

FIELD.NAME: cardsummary
FIELD.COMMENT: The plain text of the category's card in its parent's grid, at most 160 characters; empty means the card shows an excerpt of the core category description.

FIELD.NAME: defaultsort
FIELD.COMMENT: The organisation an address naming none gets: category, name or recent; empty for the theme's default (category).

FIELD.NAME: publicdescription
FIELD.COMMENT: What a visitor who is not logged in reads on the public page of a published category.

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: The id of the user who last saved the branding, kept as an authorship stamp. A deleted account leaves its stub row in the user table, so the id then names nobody.
